policy: Only report and track physically installed hardware. Never fabricate or assume presence of unverified GPIO sensors until physically connected.

bluetooth_speakers.name: JX-BT
bluetooth_speakers.profile: A2DP stereo only (HSP/HFP disabled via WirePlumber)

host_bluetooth_adapter.firmware_policy: Factory ROM (build 0000). Do NOT load BCM20702A1-0a5c-21f4.hcd patch as it causes link tx timeout and stalls ACL packets on A0 revision.
host_bluetooth_adapter.wireplumber_config: ~/.config/wireplumber/bluetooth.lua.d/51-bluez-a2dp-only.lua (forces pure A2DP stereo, disables 8kHz CVSD headset profile)

audio_troubleshooting_state.last_known_issue: Sound pitched/wavered then went silent; ACL transmission stalled due to firmware revision mismatch
next_steps_checklist: 1. Run scripts/remove_bt_firmware.sh from user terminal (sudo required) to purge incompatible BCM20702A1 patch and restart bluetoothd cleanly
2. Power-cycle JX-BT physical receiver and check physical AUX cable / amp volume knob
3. Test local audio playback using pw-play to verify direct baseline PipeWire -> JX-BT output
4. Start radio stream via webapp API using native pipewiresink
5. Compare with JBL Clip 5 (F8:5C:7E:EE:7D:CC) to isolate receiver vs adapter issues
